heading: EXT. PUBLIC POOL - DIVING PLATFORM - LATE AFTERNOON

units.text: EXT. PUBLIC POOL - DIVING PLATFORM - LATE AFTERNOON
An empty municipal pool at closing time.
The water is green-blue and still.
A ten-meter platform rises above it, rust at the joints, a faded sign reading DIVE AT OWN RISK.

NOOR, fifteen, in a black one-piece and a wet towel around her shoulders, stands at the base of the ladder with her toes curled around the bottom rung, and FELIX, sixteen, her older cousin, in cutoffs and a tank top, sits in a plastic lifeguard chair eating sunflower seeds and spitting the shells into the pool, and neither of them says anything for a while, and the filter hums, and the drain gurgles, and a plane crosses the pink sky.
You don't have to.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I know.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: It's just a platform.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It's ten meters.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: It's ten meters of nothing, then water.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: That's what I'm afraid of.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: She puts a foot on the second rung.
Takes it off.
Felix watches without comment, rolling a seed between his teeth.
Dad did it when he was fourteen.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Uncle Rob never did anything he said he did.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: Okay, that's fair.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: She climbs three rungs, then four, then stops, her knuckles pale on the rail.
Felix stands up, tosses the empty seed bag into a trash can, and walks to the edge of the pool.
He kneels there, looking up.
I'll be right here.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: You can't catch me from ten meters.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: I'll catch you after.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: She exhales.
Climbs.
The rungs ring under her feet.
At the top, she stands at the edge of the board with her arms wrapped around herself, her wet hair dripping.
Far below, Felix is very small.
Don't watch.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: I'm watching.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Felix!
units.name: NOOR

units.text: Okay, I'm not watching.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: He covers his eyes with both hands.
She laughs, a breath of a sound, and steps off.
